title: elaphrium odoratum
intro: Elaphrium odoratum, commonly known as the "sugar apple tree", is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the Annonaceae family. The health benefits of Elaphrium odoratum include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Elaphrium odoratum include annonaceous acetogenins, which have been shown to exhibit potent cytotoxic and antiproliferative effects.
